title: TXT parser treats in-body round attempt lines ending with ellipsis as chapters
symptom: In the external novel corpus at `/Users/longshengxi/Downloads/小说测试集`, 《玩家救世指南》 contains in-body retry/round markers inside `第26章`, including `第十一回 。`, `第十二回 。`, `第十三回 ……`, and `第十九回 。`. Before the fix, only `第十三回 ……` was parsed as a chapter title because ellipsis was not covered by the existing punctuation guard, producing an extra TOC entry and splitting the real chapter body.
root_cause: ChapterDetectionRules rejected Chinese numbered candidates that ended in sentence punctuation such as `。`, but it did not reject the `回` suffix when the text after the suffix was only an ellipsis. The corpus evidence showed this shape was a body retry marker, while real pure-ellipsis chapter titles in the same corpus used the `章` suffix, such as `第95章 ……`, `第107章 ……`, and `第140章 ……` in 《我在古代搞建设》.
fix: Add a narrow Chinese numbered heading guard that rejects only `回` candidates whose tail after the suffix is non-empty and contains only punctuation or ellipsis characters.
Keep `章`, `节`, `话`, and `集` behavior unchanged so real chapter titles such as `第95章 ……` remain valid.
Keep `第十回` and `第十回 标题……` valid because they are either empty-tail chapter headings or contain real title text after the suffix.

Add parser-level coverage that keeps `第十三回 ……` and its following prose inside the surrounding chapter body, plus external-corpus assertions for both the false positive and real ellipsis-ending titles.
failed_attempts: Do not add `…` to the global `sentenceEndings` set; that rejects real corpus headings like `第95章 ……`.
Do not reject pure-punctuation tails for every Chinese numbered suffix; the confirmed bad shape is `回` as an in-story retry marker, while `章` has confirmed real headings ending with pure ellipsis.
Do not rely on the external corpus smoke test's coarse 80% chapter-count threshold alone; it can pass while a specific false-positive TOC entry remains.
Do not treat the remaining `EXTRA | 番外` diagnostic in 《末世反派是我的工作搭子》 as this bug; `rg` context shows it is an isolated special chapter heading followed by new body text.
impact: New imports of TXT novels no longer create a false TOC chapter from in-story retry markers like `第十三回 ……`, while preserving real ellipsis-ending chapter titles and exact body offsets.
